run_vrp_datagen: run the python module to generate 100000 VRP samples with 20 customers and capacity 30
run_vrp_datagen_custom: run the python module to generate VRP data with custom num_customers max_demand and capacity
run_vrp_datagen_seeded: run the python module to generate reproducible VRP data by setting a random seed
review_main: review the python main function that generates VRP samples and splits them into train val and test sets
refactor_sample_pos: refactor the python sample_pos function to support configurable position ranges instead of fixed 0 to 1
